gameID.description: The unique ID linking this card to its base game engine context (e.g., 'core').

setID.description: The lowercase ID of the card set this asset belongs to.

cardID.description: The unique identification string/index for this card profile.

name.description: The display name printed on the card face.

cost.description: The resources or energy cost required to play this card.

face.description: The relative path to the card face art texture graphic asset.

frame.description: The frame texture path override. Must be present, but can be left blank ("") to inherit the Set's default frame fallback.

values.description: The table of card value names and values

effects.description: The array of card effect names
